name: RingChart.data
description: Data array - each item represents a ring

name: RingChart.size
description: Chart size in pixels. If not provided, uses parent container size

name: RingChart.strokeWidth
description: Stroke width of each ring. Default: 12

name: RingChart.ringGap
description: Gap between rings. Default: 6

name: RingChart.baseInnerRadius
description: Inner radius of the innermost ring. Default: 60

name: RingChart.animationDuration
description: Animation duration in milliseconds. Default: 1100

name: RingChart.className
description: Additional class name for the container

name: RingChart.hoveredIndex
description: Controlled hover state - index of hovered ring

name: RingChart.onHoverChange
description: Callback when hover state changes

name: RingChart.startAngle
description: Start angle in radians. Default: -PI/2

name: RingChart.endAngle
description: End angle in radians. Default: 3*PI/2 (full circle)

name: RingChart.enterTransition
description: Motion transition for ring enter animation; overrides animationDuration

name: RingChart.enterStaggerScale
description: Scales ring stagger delays (1 = default).

name: RingChart.geometryScrubbing
description: High-frequency geometry updates use plain SVG paths. Default: false

name: RingChart.children
description: Child components (Ring, RingCenter, etc.)

name: Ring.index
description: Index of this ring in the input array

name: Ring.color
description: Overrides this ring's chart token color

name: Ring.animate
description: Enable entrance animation. Default: true

name: Ring.showGlow
description: Show hover glow. Default: true

name: Ring.lineCap
description: End cap style. Default: "round"

name: RingCenter.defaultLabel
description: Label shown below the value. Default: "Total" when not hovering

name: RingCenter.formatOptions
description: Format options for NumberFlow. Default: standard notation

name: RingCenter.children
type: (props: { value: number; label: string; isHovered: boolean; data: { label: string; value: number; maxValue: number; color?: string }; }) => ReactNode
description: Custom render function for complete control over center content

name: RingCenter.className
description: Additional class name for the container

name: RingCenter.valueClassName
description: Class name for the value text. Scales with center size via container queries.

name: RingCenter.labelClassName
description: Class name for the label text. Scales with center size via container queries.

name: RingCenter.prefix
description: Prefix to show before the number (e.g., "$")

name: RingCenter.suffix
description: Suffix to show after the number (e.g., "%")
